subject: gk
question: Which of the following is INCORRECTLY matched?

options.text: Mountain climate - Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and Jharkhand
Tropical monsoon climate - The Western Ghats, the Malabar Coast and southern Assam
Tropical semi-arid (steppe) climate - Karnataka, central Maharashtra, some parts of Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh
Hot deserts, arid climate - Rajasthan and some parts of Gujarat

solution:
The correct answer is __**Montane climate - Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and Jharkhand**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mountain ****Climate**: This is not exactly a category on Köppen’s climate classification but is typically characterized by cooler temperatures due to higher altitudes, and it is associated with mountainous regions.

 
 
• Examples can be found in the Himalayan range, parts of the Andes, and the Rocky Mountains.
 
 
 
• Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and Jharkhand are not predominantly mountainous regions.
 
• More accurately, the montane climate is seen in states like Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Sikkim, Arunachal Pradesh, and parts of states like Jammu & Kashmir or Ladakh, where the Himalayan range is present.

Therefore, this matching of **"Montane Climate - Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and Jharkhand" is incorrectly matched**.<span style=&quo
